description: This file defines the AddressesScreen widget and related UI components for managing addresses in a Flutter e-commerce app. It includes imports, a StatelessWidget class for the addresses list, and internal widgets for address cards, empty states, and error states.

classes.name: AddressesScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying a list of user addresses with options to add, edit, delete, and set default addresses.

classes.name: _AddressCard
classes.description: Widget representing individual address details with actions for editing, deleting, and setting default.

classes.name: _EmptyState
classes.description: UI shown when there are no addresses, prompting user to add a new address.

classes.name: _ErrorState
classes.description: UI displayed when an error occurs loading addresses, with a retry option.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the AddressesScreen widget tree, displaying a list of addresses or relevant states.
